name: GA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Sanford Bishop running with a large fundraising edge ($1.1M raised vs $206K, $448K cash on hand)
District leans Democratic with a +4 PVI and fundamentals point to a wide margin
Challenger Matt Day has minimal cash ($1,768) and no outside spending support
Prediction markets price Bishop at ~94% to win
model.rationale: Bishop combines incumbency, a Democratic-leaning district, and an overwhelming financial advantage against a poorly funded challenger, while markets price him near certain. With no polls available, the forecast rests on these fundamentals, which all point the same direction.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or polling showing the challenger competitive would be the first sign this race is closer than fundamentals suggest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Southwest Georgia's 2nd District has a modest Democratic lean, and longtime incumbent Sanford Bishop is seeking another term. He has raised over $1.1 million and holds about $448,000 on hand, while Republican challenger Matt Day has raised roughly $206,000 with under $2,000 remaining. No outside groups are active in the race, and no public general-election polling is available.

Prediction markets give Bishop about a 94% chance of winning, and the district's fundamentals point to a comfortable margin. Absent unexpected spending or a shift in the political environment, this race is expected to remain safely in Democratic hands.
